description:
Search employers by their working-hours policy.

This answers "which companies offer a 4-day week" style questions at the employer level, where the policy actually lives, rather than per listing. The same schedule_type semantics as search_jobs apply: "compressed_week" is a 4x10 and is not a 4-day week.

Two location facts are separate and are often confused. country is where the employer is based. hires_worldwide is whether it accepts applicants from any country. remote_level is its office-presence policy, and a fully-remote employer can still hire in one country only.

Each result carries the employer's name, slug, url, schedule type, full-time hours, remote level and count of open roles. get_company takes the slug and returns the full profile.

Paging works as in search_jobs: at most 25 employers per call, with page, page_size, returned, total_matching, has_more and next_page.

country.description: Country name. This is where the employer is based, which is a different question from where it will hire — see hires_worldwide.

has_jobs.description: Only employers with at least one live listing.

hires_worldwide.description: Only employers that accept applicants from any country.

query.description: Free-text search over company name and website.

remote_level.description: The employer's office-presence policy. One of fully-remote, hybrid, onsite. Independent of hires_worldwide: a fully-remote employer can still hire in one country only.

schedule_type.description: Filter by the employer's schedule policy, e.g. 4_day_week.

sort.description: Result order. One of score (work-life score, highest first), jobs (most open roles), alphabetical, newest. Omit for the site's default order.
